resources.string: Moving the cursor with the space bar
Hold or slide along the space bar: the cursor goes through the text to the left or right, from one line to the next.

Hold the space bar: the labels disappear and the keyboard works as a trackpad. A finger at its edge keeps the cursor going, so there is no need to lift it. Moving up and down works in multi-line fields.
Recent clips on the suggestion strip and the clipboard history
The clipboard button and recent clips are hidden, and copied items are not saved. The saved history is kept.
Show recently copied text and images on the suggestion strip
Show links, e-mail addresses and phone numbers found in the recently copied text
The history stays on this phone, holds the last 30 items and skips what apps mark as sensitive, such as passwords. Screenshots are not collected automatically.
Offline speech recognition, dictation and text processing
Shape of the "?123" and action keys
Like the letter keys instead of a pill
The Enter key and the magnifier, like the letter keys instead of a pill
Change only the Enter key color
With any theme, the Classic colors stay and only the Enter key takes the color of the chosen theme
Use a dark color for icons
Icons without a color of their own: the panel above the keys, Shift, delete and the language key

Tap the microphone in the top right corner of the keyboard and speak. The phone\'s system service, usually Google, recognizes the speech: audio may be sent to its servers. You can choose another option under Recognition.
Tap the microphone in the top right corner of the keyboard and speak. Your server recognizes the speech: every phrase is sent there.
Tap the microphone in the top right corner of the keyboard and speak. Speech is recognized on the device by the Govorun app, without internet. Audio stays on the phone.
System recognition is ready · in the layout language
This phone has no system recognition: choose Govorun or your server
Works right away, in the layout language. Audio may go to Google servers
A separate app, Russian only. Works without internet, but has to be installed and connected
Recognition on the server · needs internet
This separate app recognizes speech for the keyboard. Accessibility does not need to be turned on for it
Govorun will ask you to allow this keyboard. Accessibility does not need to be turned on for it
Govorun is not responding: update it or open it once
The keyboard needs access to the microphone
Android does not let a keyboard ask for permissions, so voice input asks here. Audio is recorded only while you dictate.
For the next recording. Without a headset the phone is used
A long pause lets you speak slowly without breaking the phrase
Classic mode: every phrase is inserted after a pause
Tap the microphone, finish speaking and tap it again to insert the text. × cancels
The microphone is shown on the strip
Android locks the screen as usual
Fix names, terms and other listed words
The edited rules have not been saved.

One rule per line as «key=value». Case does not matter.

A line without «=» removes the word from the recognized text.
A line starting with «#» is a comment.

Line break: «новая строка=\n». Empty line: «новый абзац=\n\n». Tab: «отступ=\t». Right of «=» write a backslash and the letter n or t, without quotes. Such a value must consist only of \n and \t; inside ordinary text they stay as they are.

Rules apply in order: put longer and more specific ones first. If you do not need the letter «ё», the rule «ё=е» replaces it in all words.

The model may hear one word in different ways: list all spellings separated by commas.

Recognized text goes to the server and its answer is inserted. Works with any recognizer and dictation mode; in «After a pause» every phrase is improved on its own. Without an answer the recognized text is inserted
A button next to the microphone sends the selection, or the whole text of the field, to the server and replaces it with the answer. The same button then brings the original back until you type again
Shorter text is inserted at once and does not go to the server. In «After a pause» every phrase is counted on its own.
How much the model thinks before it answers. Lower is faster and cheaper, higher is more careful. Sent as reasoning_effort; a model that does not support it may reject the request.
Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
HTTP or SOCKS5 without login and password. The proxy also takes part in the data transfer.
Every phrase is sent to the server. If the server does not answer, the phrase is not inserted
ISO 639-1 code such as ru or en. Empty lets the server detect it
The server gets the audio with no extra instructions
Your text goes with every phrase to guide the model
A hint for the model: style, names, terms. Whisper takes it as a sample rather than a command, so write it in the language of your speech
Choose a prompt or the «Voice only» mode

Only technical error reports are sent: the kind of error, the place in the code, the app version and the phone model. Nothing you type or say, no clipboard, no addresses, keys or other personal data. Off by default.
Turn Shift on at the start of a sentence or field when the field asks for it, and turn it off after a letter
Show the button on the strip
Adds a button to the strip that opens the text of the field above the keys, up to the top of the screen. It may not work properly in some apps.
A tap on the delete key always removes one character. Below you choose what happens if you keep holding it.
Default. Characters go one after another, quickly, while the key is held.
Whole words go one after another together with the spaces after them. Punctuation and line breaks go apart.
After a long hold the whole text of the field is deleted at once, including the text after the cursor.
Holding does nothing, the key removes one character per tap. Protects from deleting too much by accident.
Type a word by sliding a finger across its letters
The built-in decoder. Works in every language.
A neural network for the Russian layout. Other languages use the default engine.
This build does not include the neural network model.
The experimental slide to type engine crashed the keyboard, so the default engine is back on.
With them the experimental engine also weighs the word before the gesture and guesses better. Downloaded from GitHub, takes %1$d MB on the phone.
Could not download the word pairs. Check the connection and try again.
Not enough space: %1$d MB is needed.
The experimental engine keeps working but no longer weighs the previous word. You can download them again.
Save all settings to a JSON file
API keys are left out by default. If you include them, they are stored in the file as plain text: anyone who gets the file can use your servers at your expense.
The file has no API keys: servers already on this phone keep their keys, new ones will need a key entered.
Could not save the settings file
Replace the current settings with the ones from a file
This file is not a settings file of this keyboard
All current settings, including servers, prompts, custom buttons and the dictionary, will be replaced with the ones from the file. This cannot be undone.
Hide categories and single emoji from the picker
Open it with a long press on the comma key
Tap an emoji to remove it from the picker or to bring it back. Removed ones are faded and crossed out.
A switched off category and removed emoji disappear from the picker and from its top row. At least one category always stays.
Switch on or off parts of a category, such as sports or games
A collection of prompts for voice input and text improvement

Give a prompt a short name and write its text. Then choose it on the pages of Dictation, Proofreading and Server recognition. Several prompts can be chosen in one place: their texts are joined into one.
A separate buffer next to the clipboard history, with a filter by prompt. A dictation adds the raw transcript and the improved text, proofreading and buttons add their answers
What the model should do or what style to expect
«%1$s» will be removed from the collection.
«%1$s» is in use: %2$s. After deleting, these places go back to the default prompt, and Dictation and Proofreading follow the shared server.
Hold the proofreading button to proofread with this prompt. Without a prompt, holding does nothing.
Several prompts are chosen: they are joined into one text in every request.
The collection is empty. Add prompts in Settings → Prompts.
Set up a server here once; dictation, proofreading and recognition on a server only choose from this list.
None yet · add the first one
That was the last text server, so dictation and proofreading are turned off. Add at least one text server to use them again.
That was the last audio server, so recognition on a server is turned off. Add at least one audio server to use it again.
«%1$s» will be removed from this device together with its saved API key.
«%1$s» will be removed from this device together with its saved API key. These will be turned off: %2$s.

Choosing this server for a function means you agree to send data to it: the text to improve, or the audio to recognize, and the API key (if set). The server owner is responsible for the data processing there.
HTTP does not encrypt the data and the key on the way.
OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions API. Choose a server whose model recognizes speech: whisper-1 or gpt-4o-mini-transcribe on OpenAI, a speech model on OpenRouter or Groq.
Choose a complete recognition server first
The audio of every phrase, the model, the language, the prompt (if chosen) and the API key (if set) go straight to the chosen server. The server owner is responsible for the data processing there.
HTTP does not encrypt the audio and the key on the way.
The full screen mode is off, so these buttons are not visible. It is turned on under Typing
Removes all the text; a second tap brings it back until you type again
Copies the selection, or all the text without one
Inserts the clipboard text at the cursor, or in place of the selection
Sends the text to a server with the chosen prompt; a second tap undoes the answer until you type again
All the text is sent, and the answer replaces it
The selection is sent, or all the text without one, and the answer replaces it
The selection is sent, or all the text without one, and the answer goes to the end of the field
The selection is sent, or all the text without one, and the answer goes to the cursor, after the selection
Delete the group with its buttons

Keyboard buttons stand on the strip above the keys while the field has text and no words are suggested, full screen buttons on the panel above the text. As many as fit are shown, in this order. Drag the icons to arrange them. There are no buttons in password fields
A group that is off is not shown on the keyboard and keeps its buttons and settings
The group will be deleted with all its buttons. This cannot be undone.
A button that is off is not shown on the keyboard and keeps its settings
No action yet: the button does nothing
Choose the prompt on every tap
The keyboard shows all your prompts, and the one you pick is sent
Choose a server and add a prompt to the collection: until then this action does nothing
Choose a server and a prompt: until then this action does nothing
Do not fit on the strip
Do not fit on the panel
Buttons that do not fit on the strip go to a row under it, which stays while you type
Narrower buttons stand closer, so more of them fit. The settings and microphone buttons keep their size
Hidden while the field is empty
Also in an empty field. Word suggestions still replace it, and password fields have no buttons
Stands on the panel above the text, not on the strip above the keys. The full screen mode is turned on under Typing
Some apps ask the keyboard not to show word suggestions, for example in a search bar. When on, the keyboard suggests words in such fields too. Password fields still get no suggestions
Suggestions cover the buttons of the strip. After this time without typing they go away and the buttons come back
Error reports and the application log
Records errors and crashes of the app so you can look them up here. Off by default.
The log is written only on this phone and is never sent anywhere. Entries older than a week are deleted automatically.
A text file with the app version, the phone and every entry
In the background, without notifications: a new version is shown at the top of the settings
Could not check for updates. Check the connection and try again.
%1$d MB from GitHub. The word pairs are updated together with the app.
Android asks once to allow installs from this app. Allow it, come back and tap again.
Could not download the update. Check the connection and try again.
The downloaded file is damaged. Try again.
The file is signed with another key than this build: install it from the release page.
Android did not install the update. The details are in the app log.
The release has no APK attached
Tap to see what is new and install it
Phrases you often type. Put them on a custom button with the «Quick replies» action: a tap on the button opens the list, and a tap on a phrase inserts it.
Add a button with the «Quick replies» action
I will call you back later
Opens the list of chosen phrases; a tap on one inserts it, and a second tap takes it back until you type again
There are no quick replies yet. Add them in the settings, under «Quick replies».
Choose at least one phrase: until then this action does nothing
The phrase replaces all the text
The phrase replaces the selection, or goes to the cursor without one
The phrase goes to the end of the field
The phrase goes to the cursor, after the selection
